ازدوجا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَوَجَا (izdawajā) /iz.da.wa.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
# اِزْدَوِجَا (izdawijā) /iz.da.wi.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
